recognize_zh: 脾臟高倍H&E中為多形性淋巴樣細胞浸潤，混有核大、核仁明顯的免疫母細胞（immunoblasts）、漿細胞樣細胞與小淋巴球，細胞大小不一且非單一族群，符合傳染性單核球增多症的反應性變化。
features: Polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes, intermediate cells and large immunoblasts
Immunoblasts with vesicular nuclei and single prominent central nucleoli
Plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei and amphophilic cytoplasm
Intervening splenic cords and endothelial cells in the red pulp
describe_en: High-power section of spleen shows the red pulp infiltrated by a polymorphous population of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells and numerous immunoblasts with vesicular nuclei and prominent central nucleoli. Occasional mitotic figures are present. The spectrum of cell sizes and maturation argues against a monotonous neoplastic infiltrate. Findings are consistent with the immunoblastic reaction of infectious mononucleosis; EBER in situ hybridization and immunophenotyping help exclude large cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: DLBCL shows sheets of monotonous large atypical cells effacing architecture, whereas here immunoblasts are admixed with a spectrum of smaller and plasmacytoid cells.
Immunoblasts can mimic Reed-Sternberg cells, but HRS cells are CD30+/CD15+/CD45-negative with weak PAX5, while IM immunoblasts are CD45+ and CD20 or CD3 positive.
PTCL shows atypical cells with irregular nuclei and aberrant T-cell antigen loss with clonal TCR rearrangement.
